summary: The deal price is ₹19,989, and the market reference is ₹24,695. Across 12 stores, the price was below the market reference, with M.R.P. at ₹34,990.

voices.point: Noise cancellation is often praised as very effective, near-silent in some use cases.
Sound quality gets mixed reactions; several users mention weak bass or muddy tuning out of the box.
Comfort is mixed: some find them lightweight, others say they feel heavy or tight.
Build concerns appear in some reviews, with reports of snapped arms or flimsy plastic.
